name: cicero
description: CICERO — the house voice. Ships the always-on communication style (readable-first, bottom line first, concise, plain language, recommend-don't-survey, push back, honesty, stay in scope) as a force-for-plugin output style, applied at the system-prompt level whenever the plugin is enabled. A SessionStart hook shows a start banner, resolves the voice language (asks once, then persists). A UserPromptSubmit hook re-asserts the user's current language each turn (adapts to mid-session switches).
